text:
sam: Heads-up — after the RBAC change to the EU KMS role we pushed ~10m ago, eu-west ingest-proxy is seeing intermittent mTLS handshake failures (tls: decryption failed) and a spike of 502/524 upstreams. Rolling back now.
alyssa: copying oncall @mike. any ETA on rollback? did we touch the HSM policy or just IAM binding? :eyes:
mike: I rolled the binding back at +2m, started routing to fallback key path. traffic looks calmer but still seeing a small tail of decrypt errors. grabbing logs.
kevin: can you paste the deny log from KMS/audit? want to know which principal and which key ARN.
security-bot: KMS DENY detected: user=svc-ingest-proxy-principal action=Decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/abcd-ef01 reason=iam:NotAuthorized  src=10.3.14.22 ts=2024-11-17T14:55:41Z
sam: here's the minimal IAM delta that caused it (from recent PR):
```
- Effect: Allow
  Action: kms:Decrypt
  Resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/abcd-ef01
  Principal: svc-ingest-proxy@prod
+ Effect: Allow
+ Action: kms:Decrypt
+ Resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/abcd-ef01/*
+ Principal: svc-ingest-proxy@prod
```
alyssa: looks like the extra trailing /* widened resource and AWS evaluated it differently for the HSM-backed key, odd. maybe the key policy rejects wildcarded ARNs?
mike: yep — HSM key policies are stricter. The wildcard made the binding fail evaluation for the HSM provider, which returned NotAuthorized for some decrypt attempts. Rolling forward to explicit key ARN fixed it.
ops-rota: quick mitigation checklist: temporarily route eu-west TLS termination to regional fallback cert, throttle new connections, enable per-ingest retry with jitter, and re-run canary.
kevin: followups: (1) add an alert on tls_decrypt_errors > 5/min for any proxy in eu-*, (2) add unit test for KMS policy lints that detect wildcards against HSM-backed keys, (3) capture the exact IAM policy diff in the postmortem.
sam: Agreed. Also adding immediate audit-sink rule so we retain raw KMS audit events for 90d in secure-logging (current retention 30d). Query example to find impacted principals: `resource="arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/abcd-ef01" AND eventName=Decrypt AND errorCode=AccessDenied`
alyssa: vuln triage note — this didn't expose plaintext, it was an availability/regression issue. Marking as sev3 for now until we confirm no dependent service retried insecurely.
mike: putting a PR to revert the wildcard and adding an automated lint that fails CI if a KMS resource contains `/*`. tagging @kevin for review.
kevin: good. also check OCSP stapling / cert chain verification timeouts — some clients fell back to 0-RTT which amplified failures. can we disable 0-RTT for eu edge until the canary is clean?
sam: disabling 0-RTT on eu edge for next 30m.
ops-rota: post-incident owners: sam (remediation), mike (iam rollbacks & canary), kevin (alerts + postmortem), alyssa (comms + sev tracking).
alyssa: I'll draft a short incident note and ping infra-team + legal if audit retention change touches compliance. :memo:
sam: thanks all. will paste final timeline and PR links here when done. :thumbsup:
